context.problem_statement: You are provided with a biomedical dataset where various biometric measurements (such as patient age, body mass index, and serum levels) are recorded along with a disease progression score. Your task is to develop a dose-response model to understand how these measurements impact disease progression. Specifically, apply non-linear curve fitting to model the relationship between body mass index and disease progression. Compute the goodness of fit using R-squared and Root Mean Square Error (RMSE) as metrics. Address any missing or noisy data appropriately.
context.expert_knowledge: Dose-response modeling often involves fitting non-linear models to data where the response variable is a function of the dose. In this task, the 'dose' can be interpreted as different biometric measurements, and the response is the disease progression. Non-linear curve fitting involves using algorithms like least squares to minimize the difference between observed and predicted values.
